summary: Attempted to reproduce reported bug 'Demo Account cannot access profile' via the actual button-click flow (no session injection). Ran two flows against the live preview URL. UNABLE TO REPRODUCE — the Demo Account button works correctly and profile access succeeds in both scenarios.

flow_a_results.description: Login page -> click Demo Account -> click Profile nav link

flow_b_results.description: Fresh context -> direct /profile (logged out) -> redirected to /login?next=/profile -> click Demo Account

conclusion: Bug CANNOT BE REPRODUCED. The Demo Account button correctly (a) POSTs /api/auth/demo returning 200 with user_id/username/email, (b) sets localStorage 'user', (c) sets the gachard_uid cookie with path=/ SameSite=Lax, (d) redirects to the `next` param (/ in Flow A, /profile in Flow B). The middleware/proxy.ts accepts the cookie and does not redirect. The /profile page reads localStorage 'user', calls /api/credits and /api/cards (both 200) and renders fully with @DemoN handle, 10,000 credit balance, rarity bar, stats, collection empty-state, and logout button. No console errors. No 4xx/5xx responses.
possible_explanations_for_original_repor: User may have tested BEFORE ENABLE_DEMO_LOGIN=true was set — in which case /api/auth/demo returns 403, localStorage/cookie are not set, and any subsequent visit to /profile correctly redirects to /login. (Note: login page also hides the demo button entirely in that case and shows 'Explore as guest' instead — but the button DID exist in earlier iterations before the gate.)

User could have had a stale localStorage 'user' from a previously deleted account (e.g., DB was reset between sessions) — but this would NOT cause a /profile -> /login redirect because proxy.ts only checks cookie existence, not validity, and profile page only checks localStorage existence. Even a stale user would render the page (though /api/credits and /api/cards might return empty).

If the deployment ran behind a cookie-stripping proxy/CDN, the gachard_uid Set-Cookie via document.cookie is client-side only, but since it's SameSite=Lax on same origin it should survive. No issue observed in preview.

Possibly a race: window.location.href = next fires immediately after localStorage.setItem, and if `next` is /profile, the middleware requires the cookie, which IS set synchronously via document.cookie before the assignment. Verified working in Flow B.

Most likely: the original report may have been from a session where ENABLE_DEMO_LOGIN was false OR the tester manually cleared cookies but not localStorage between tests. In the current preview build both flows are green.
action_items: No code changes required. The Demo Account -> /profile flow is fully functional in the current preview build. Recommend main agent close the bug as 'cannot reproduce' or ask reporter for exact repro steps / browser / console output.

Optional hardening (not required): the /profile page's client-side gate only checks localStorage existence, not that user_id matches cookie. If a user clears the cookie but keeps localStorage, /profile would still render but middleware would have already redirected. Not a real issue but worth noting.
critical_code_review_comments: app/api/auth/demo/route.ts uses MongoDB counters findOneAndUpdate with `_id: 'demo_account'` as string — works but note _id string vs ObjectId consistency.
login/page.tsx line 47: document.cookie set with SameSite=Lax is correct; no Secure flag but HTTPS preview works fine.

profile/page.tsx uses window.location.replace('/login') on missing localStorage — this bypasses the `next` param, so a user with valid cookie but no localStorage would loop briefly. Not observed in tests but a latent edge case. Consider `window.location.replace('/login?next=/profile')`.

proxy.ts is named 'proxy' but exports function `proxy` — Next.js middleware convention is `middleware.ts` with `export function middleware(...)`. Since the file is named proxy.ts and the export is `proxy`, Next.js may only pick it up if configured. However, since the guard IS working (deep-link to /profile correctly redirects to /login?next=/profile), it is registered. No action needed but naming is non-standard.
test_credentials: Demo Account button (auto-provisions @DemoN sandbox users). ENABLE_DEMO_LOGIN=true confirmed.
seed_data_creation: Two demo users auto-created by button clicks: Demo11 (6a69ab5d1d341a447e3db0b4) and Demo12 (6a69ab761d341a447e3db0b5), each with 10,000 credits.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug 'Demo Account cannot access profile' is NOT REPRODUCIBLE in preview. If user re-reports, gather: (1) console output, (2) network tab showing /api/auth/demo response, (3) document.cookie value after click, (4) exact browser + whether third-party cookies are blocked. Note previous iteration_8 also reported /profile worked for demo — consistent with this iteration.
rca of the issue: No RCA — bug not reproducible. Full evidence collected in flow_a_results and flow_b_results above. All 3 API calls returned 200, cookie + localStorage both set, /profile rendered fully authenticated with expected @DemoN handle, credit balance, and rarity bar.
